title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash use statement placed mid-file in reader/config.rs
description: reader/src/config.rs line 281 has a bare 'use stoa_auth::looks_like_bcrypt_hash;' statement placed mid-file between other struct/fn definitions rather than at the top of the file with other imports (lines 1-16). For a contributor reading the file top-to-bottom, finding a use statement 280 lines in is surprising. Move to top-of-file with the other use declarations.
